## 主张 Claim

一步上，一个条件的水平按流所给、所取改变，恰当流在那里平衡。不平衡之处，把差额算作又一个关系项 none 的交换：它给每个条件其水平超出流的净交换而升的部分，取其超出而降的部分（Flow.withImbalance，Flow.withImbalance_given、Flow.withImbalance_taken）；依存网照 rest-with-refinement-counted 的细分读入它：从不活跃，不要求任何东西（Web.withRefinement）。于是扩展的流在每一步、每个条件上平衡（Flow.withImbalance_balances），在每个家族上亦然（Flow.withImbalance_balancesOn）。流在一个家族上跨一步平衡，恰当新增的关系项在那里对其成员不给不取（Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle），处处平衡恰当它处处闲置（Flow.balances_iff_idle）。两种表示逐步等价：在一步一个条件上，扩展的流中只有活跃者给予，恰当原流中只有活跃者给予且水平不超出净交换而升（Flow.withImbalance_acting_at_iff）；只有活跃者取、只取其所汲取的，恰当原流如此且水平不超出净交换而降（Flow.withImbalance_taking_at_iff）；所以在一个家族上跨一步，二者在扩展的流上成立，恰当二者在原流上成立且流在那里平衡（Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff）；全步全条件的形式是推论（Flow.withImbalance_acting_iff、Flow.withImbalance_taking_iff、Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_iff）。自然数的截断减法不丢失信息：给与取各取一边的差额，一边为零（sub_eq_zero_of_le、le_of_sub_eq_zero）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Across a step, a condition's level changes by what the flow gives and takes exactly where the flow balances there. Wherever it does not, the difference is counted as the exchange of one more relatum, none: it gives each condition what its level rose beyond the flow's net exchange, and takes what its level fell beyond it (Flow.withImbalance, Flow.withImbalance_given, Flow.withImbalance_taken); the web reads it as the refinement of rest-with-refinement-counted is read, never active and requiring nothing (Web.withRefinement). Then the extended flow balances at every step and condition (Flow.withImbalance_balances), and on every family (Flow.withImbalance_balancesOn). The flow balances on a family across a step exactly where the added relatum neither gives nor takes on its members there (Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle), and everywhere exactly where it is idle everywhere (Flow.balances_iff_idle). The two representations are equivalent step by step: at a step and condition, in the extended flow only active relata give exactly where only active relata give in the flow and the level does not rise beyond the flow's net exchange (Flow.withImbalance_acting_at_iff), and only active relata take, and only what they draw on, exactly where they do so in the flow and the level does not fall beyond it (Flow.withImbalance_taking_at_iff); so on a family across a step both hold of the extended flow exactly where both hold of the flow and it balances there (Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff), the forms over every step and condition being corollaries (Flow.withImbalance_acting_iff, Flow.withImbalance_taking_iff, Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_iff). Truncated subtraction loses nothing: giving and taking each take one side of the difference, the other being zero (sub_eq_zero_of_le, le_of_sub_eq_zero). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 任意流与依存网；新增的关系项从不活跃、不要求任何东西。 / Any flow and web; the added relatum is never active and requires nothing.
- 离散的步；自然数的水平。 / Discrete steps; natural-number levels.

Ren 2026-10-11 以“please”接受 AI 的建议：把不平衡算作关系项，先作为与现行表示等价的表示加以证明，是否采用由 Ren 定（零前提计划 §1.4 的重新奠定）；Ren 2026-10-14 采用。AI 的读法：算入不平衡后，平衡是表示的性质，它对世界所说的改由一个关系项的不活跃来说。核心的规律仍以 Flow.BalancesOn 为局部条件。 / Ren, 11 October 2026: “please”, to the AI's suggestion that counting an imbalance as a relatum first be proved as a representation equivalent to the current one, adoption staying with Ren (the re-founding of the zero-premise plan, section 1.4); Ren adopted it on 14 October 2026. The AI's reading: with the imbalance counted, balance is a property of the representation, and what it said of a world is said instead by the inactivity of one relatum. The laws of the core keep Flow.BalancesOn as a local condition.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.Imbalance 的 15 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T095049.338744Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §85；尚未经独立审查。 / Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 15 theorems of Becoming.Imbalance all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §85 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

这是表示之间的等价，使采用无损：核心的规律仍以平衡为局部条件；等价不说明哪种读法更好，也不说明世界在哪里平衡；只对离散步与自然数的量陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；尚无独立审查。 / This is an equivalence of representations, which makes the adoption lossless: the laws of the core keep balance as a local condition; the equivalence says neither which reading is better nor where a world balances; stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; not yet independently reviewed.

- unbalanced 世界，即没有流的 Shuttle 两侧，满足平衡以外的每个前提（World.unbalanced_but）：平衡是世界在满足其余前提时仍可不满足的条件。算入不平衡不去掉这一条件，只移动它：流在一个家族上跨一步平衡，恰当新增的关系项在那里闲置（Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle）；扩展的流在那里满足活动前提，恰当原流满足它们且在那里平衡（Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff）。采用之后，这一条件仍是部分的状态：其余是否闲置（World.withRest_closed_iff）。 / The unbalanced world, the sides of Shuttle with no flow, meets every premise but balance (World.unbalanced_but): balance is a condition a world can fail while meeting the others. Counting the imbalance does not remove the condition but moves it: a flow balances on a family across a step exactly where the added relatum is idle there (Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle), and the extended flow meets the activity premises there exactly where the flow meets them and balances there (Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff). Adopted, the condition stays a state of a part: whether the rest is idle (World.withRest_closed_iff). ## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

核心现有的规律在 Flow.BalancesOn 上的陈述是否改写为其余在该家族上闲置（每条经 Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle 等价）；实际生成中其余是什么（它的交换作为差读出，不是观察）；独立审查。 / Whether the existing laws stated on Flow.BalancesOn are rewritten as the rest idle on the family (each is equivalent through Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle); what the rest is in an actual becoming (its exchange is read off as a difference, not observed); an independent review.
